project.name: Clunk
project.summary: An open-source WebMCP repair bench where a person supplies physical observations and an AI navigates source-backed appliance checks, highlights the physical location, and resolves an exact seller link when compatibility evidence is complete.
project.ai_usage: A compatible browser agent can discover all eight in-page WebMCP tools from page load. Each result reports the currently valid nextTools, while Clunk's deterministic engine rejects out-of-order, unsupported, unsafe, or post-terminal calls. The shipped site does not call a model. Lovable is used for hosting and GitHub sync.
project.codex_usage: Codex supported scoping, implementation, debugging, accessibility, deterministic testing, live browser verification, and open-source and Devpost documentation.

required_external_steps: Approve and publish a replacement public YouTube demo under three minutes with audio, captions, accurate all-eight-tool wording, and clearly visible client discovery and calls
Log in to Devpost, join the hackathon, create the Clunk project, and paste the prepared copy and links
Choose submitter type, country, app status, learning level, and career-value answers, then review and approve final submission
